aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:864.title: Ontario Reign - Ticket Operations & Marketing Coordinator
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:864.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! JOB DESCRIPTION: The Ticket Operations & Marketing Coordinator handles the day-to-day execution and coordination across ticket sales and marketing operations to drive revenue and deliver a great fan experience. This position will organize the outside events calendar and support event execution. They will also be responsible for supporting the theme night and special event execution for all games. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Support the planning and and execution of theme nights from concept through in-game delivery, including coordinating logistics, promotional elements, and in-arena activations. Serves as the primary point of contact for suite bookings and food voucher programs, working directly with arena staff to coordinate ticket delivery, catering orders, and digital voucher distribution to ensure a smooth experience for all guests. Create ticket pack links across sales platforms, fulfill orders, and coordinate with the Marketing Manager to choose items. Assist the Ticketing departments with CRM database management for season ticket holders, single seat ticket holders, and potential leads. Research and identify events in the community to participate in that drive brand recognition and ticket sales. Support the logistics and the execution of the events. Support miscellaneous initiatives as the departments needs arise throughout the season such as season ticket holder initiatives, gifts, events, and collateral. SPECIFIC JOB KNOWLEDGE, SKILL AND ABILITY: The Ticket Operations & Marketing Coordinator must possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities and be able to explain and demonstrate that he or she can perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, using some other combination of skill and abilities: Excellent customer service skills with a strong work ethic Ability to create positive and strong working relationships Assertive, persistent and results oriented with the ability to multitask Ability to thrive in a competitive sales environment Effective written and communication skills and display an excellent phone presence Knowledge of computer programs such as Microsoft Word and Outlook. Ability to learn required business systems Knowledge of ticketing software preferred. Flexible hours required: working evenings/nights, weekends and holidays as needed QUALIFICATION STANDARDS: Education: High School Diploma or its equivalency (BA/BS Degree Preferred) Experience: 2-4 years related work experience Experience in customer service Experience and interest in the sports and entertainment industry preferred Payscale: $19.50 - $23.00 Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. Benefits Full-time : We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k

americanoperator-americanoperator:ashbyh.description: American Operator is hiring a VP, Operator Selection & Experience to build the network and development platform for exceptional leaders who want to become CEOs and owners of small businesses. This role owns the full operator lifecycle: attracting and selecting outstanding leaders, preparing them for ownership, matching them with the right businesses, and supporting their success after placement. The mandate is broader than recruiting, it is to make the American Operator network a differentiated source of talent, community, and long-term value creation. The ideal candidate is a strategic talent leader and hands-on builder with experience across executive talent, leadership development, and private-equity-backed businesses. This role will report to the CEO. RESPONSIBILITIES - Define American Operator’s operator talent strategy, aligned with its investment pipeline, industries, and geographies. - Build and engage a high-quality operator network before specific acquisition needs arise. - Own operator selection and matching, including success profiles, assessments, interviews, references, and final recommendations. - Create a compelling experience and value proposition for prospective, qualified, and placed operators. - Build pre-placement education, onboarding, and ongoing development programs, including peer learning, mentorship, and coaching. - Partner with the investment and operating teams to support operator transitions, first-100-day plans, and long-term success. - Track the health of the operator platform through measures such as bench quality, engagement, match quality, retention, and post-placement outcomes. - Lead a small team while remaining personally involved with priority operators and critical selection decisions. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS - 8+ years in executive talent, leadership development, talent strategy, private-equity portfolio support, or a related field. - Experience building a talent, leadership, or executive network, not only executing searches. - Strong judgment in executive assessment, matching, and leadership transitions. - Experience supporting leaders through onboarding, development, coaching, or peer programming. - Strong business and financial acumen; familiarity with M&A and private-equity value creation is preferred. - Executive presence and the ability to build trust with investors, business owners, and senior operators. - A builder’s mindset and the ability to move between strategy and hands-on execution. COMPENSATION The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. Total compensation may also include a discretionary performance-based bonus and equity. Please note that compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, education, skills, and other qualifications specific to the role. $150K - $200K BENEFITS Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, a company-matched 401(k), unlimited PTO, paid holidays, and paid parental leave. ABOUT THE TEAM American Operator exists because we believe the American Dream is worth protecting, and that small businesses are the backbone of our communities. To do this well, we need a team that reflects the real world: operators, builders, investors, and problem-solvers from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. We know that diversity of thought, discipline, and lived experience leads to better decisions and stronger businesses. We’re intentional about bringing together people who care deeply about ownership, stewardship, and keeping great companies in capable hands. Our work depends on collaboration, humility, and a shared belief in the value of Main Street. We’re a team shaped by different industries, hometowns, and career paths, and we believe those differences are exactly what prepare us to serve small-business owners and future CEOs across the country.
